decisions.text: behaviour: the past-counts list shows every count the server returns for the business, drafts and finished, with no per-user filter for staff — reverse: filter drafts by createdBy as loadOpenDraft does
behaviour: a finished count in the list is shown but not clickable; only a draft opens on the sheet — reverse: allow opening a finished count read-only
behaviour: a row whose unit needs a fix is not counted, is not saved in the draft and has its counted box disabled until a unit is picked — reverse: save such rows with an empty unit

behaviour: the add-unit option uses the existing key add_new_unit («הוסף יחידה חדשה») instead of a new unit_add key, and opens the product-mode unit creator; the new unit is saved onto the product's purchase options — reverse: add unit_add and switch the label
behaviour: the move-counted button uses the registered chevron-up icon because arrow-up and chevrons-up are not registered — reverse: register an icon in app.config.ts
behaviour: a pick of a product for a line whose unit the product lacks flags the row for a unit fix instead of using the base unit — reverse: fall back to the base unit
behaviour: the draft autosaves silently, with no success toast; the line «נשמר אוטומטית · HH:mm» replaces the old «ממשיכים טיוטה…» note — reverse: restore the stk_draft_from note

behaviour: the AI prompt now tells the model to return an unspoken-list unit word as said, so «ארגזים» reaches the server and is matched to the product's units instead of being dropped to null — reverse: restore the old prompt line
